text:
Aisha (CS): Quick signal dump from last 3 onboarding cohorts — consolidated into the sheet: https://redwood.app/sheets/onboard-signals

Aisha (CS): Top asks repeated across customers: 1) per-route cost breakdown in console (granular billing), 2) faster embedding refresh workflow, 3) per-team prompt template support. Also a few notes about UX friction on project renaming.

Maya (CS Ops): +1 — HelixHealth and Gridly both flagged per-route cost as blocker to approval. Renewal windows: HelixHealth 2026-02-10, Gridly 2026-03-05.  :warning:

Liam (CS Data): Quick numbers: 12 mentions of \"cost per route\" across tickets, avg sentiment -0.6. Embedding-refresh asked 7x. Putting sample quotes in the doc.

Eva (Product): Thanks — can you paste 2 short customer quotes here and mark which are renewal-risk? Also any workaround they're using now?

Aisha (CS): Quotes pasted from doc:
```
\"We can't show customers per-route charges, so finance is blocking rollout." — HelixHealth (renewal-risk)
\"Refreshing embeddings takes ~3 hours and we need sub-30m for our daily pipeline." — Gridly
```
Workarounds: exporting logs+hand-calculating cost, manual embedding re-run via script.

Jon (PM): Proposal: split into Quick Win (console per-route toggle + CSV export) vs Roadmap (embedding refresh service). Quick Win target: 2-week spike + ship subset. Who can own spike?

Priya (Eng): Can do spike for CSV export + UI filter. Estimate 3 dev-days + 2 QA-days. Embedding service is medium-sized: 4-6 sprints unless we scope a minimal version (cached refresh endpoint) — could be 3 sprints.

Eva (Product): Good. @Priya please add ticket to \"inbox\" and tag as spike vs epic. @Jon can you prioritize in next planning? I'll mark HelixHealth as high touch and set up a short call with them if we need requirements.

Maya (CS Ops): I'll schedule customer calls and capture any additional asks. Adding docs links and a couple of examples in sheet.

cs-bot: Automated note: thread converted to product board card #PLAT-498 and linked to https://redwood.app/board/PLAT-498 :white_check_mark:

Aisha (CS): Next steps I propose:
- Maya: customer interviews this week (scheduled)
- Priya: start spike next Tue
- Jon/Eva: confirm priority and quick-win acceptance criteria
I'll update the sheet with interview notes. Thanks all :pray:

Priya (Eng): Ack, starting spike Tue. Will post quick design notes here.

Jon (PM): I'll slot quick-win into sprint if Eva signs off today.

Eva (Product): Signed off. :rocket: Let's aim to show HelixHealth a prototype before their renewal meeting.

Maya (CS Ops): Noted, booking demo slot 2026-01-25 10am PT.
